sources: trip_data/ridb_campsites.json (RIDB campsite catalog for facility 234253, fetched 2026-10-20)

values.note: Standard electric/water site $30 a night (2026 and 2027 rate seasons); group site $125, group shelter $50.

fees.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/234253/rates (Peak Season 2026-09-02 to 2026-09-06 and 2027-05-31 to 2027-09-06: STANDARD ELECTRIC 30, GROUP STANDARD ELECTRIC 125, GROUP SHELTER ELECTRIC 50), read 2026-10-22

hookups.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/234253 ('32 campsites available, all with electric hookups') + RIDB catalog (all 32 STANDARD ELECTRIC sites: Electricity Hookup 50, Water Hookup Yes; no sewer attribute), read 2026-10-22

values.note: 32 electric/water sites plus one large group site. 3 pull-throughs, 29 back-ins; catalog Max Vehicle Length 28-90 ft on most sites (two read 129 and 143 ft, pad lengths or typos), so no maximum is recorded. Most sites have gravel bases.

sites.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/234253 ('There are 32 campsites available, all with electric hookups, and one large group site'; 'Most campsites have a gravel bases') + RIDB catalog (Max Vehicle Length, Driveway Entry per site), read 2026-10-22

values.note: Playground, sandy beach, basketball court, horseshoe pit; the Overmountain Victory NHT passes the lake.

facilities.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/234253 ('Modern amenities like flush toilets, drinking water and showers'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: Camping 'only permitted to those who have a reservation' (recreation.gov, 877-444-6777, or the app); the gatehouse makes no changes. If no attendant is present, guests self-check in with a gate code emailed at booking. 14 nights in any 30 days. Check-in 3 pm, check-out noon.

booking.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/234253 (notices: 'Camping is permitted in designated campsites only, and only permitted to those who have a reservation', 'Maximun stay is 14 days within any 30 day period', gatehouse/gate-code and check-in notices; facility_rules maxStay 14 nights 'Rolling 30 Days'), read 2026-10-22

discounts.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/234253 ('Golden Age/Access and America the Beautiful Interagency Senior and Access Passes are accepted at this campground. Cardholders receive a 50% discount on camping fees.'), read 2026-10-22

summary: USACE-run (not concession), reservation-only. Confirmed $30 base, 50-amp electric + water. Added 32 sites with 3 pull-throughs, flush toilets/showers/water, no first-come camping, 14-night max, senior/access 50% discount. Not stated: sewer, dump station, a campground season statement (rate seasons vary: 2027 May 31-Sep 6; the calendar for 2026-27 is sparse), booking window. USACE district page did not answer plain HTTP.
